v.s: Valentina casts (Shadow Strike) in the target direction, dealing 300( +165% Total Magic Power) (Magic Damage) to enemies hit and slowing them by 40% for 1s.\nEnemy heroes hit by (Shadow Strike) are marked with a Shadow Sigil for 4s and will be (terrified) for 1s when hit by (Shadow Strike) again within the duration (a unit can only be terrified once within 4s).
Shadow Strike is Valentina's main damage source as well as her harass tool.

Valentina dashes in the target direction, firing 3 Shadow Bolts at nearby enemies that deal 125( +30% Total Magic Power) (Magic Damage) each. Valentina can cast this skill again within 6s (costs Mana).\nThe cooldown of (Shadow Strike) is reduced by 1s each time a Shadow Bolt hits an enemy.

When each Shadow Bolt hits an enemy hero, it reduces the cooldown of Shadow Strike, granting Valentina extra chances to dish out even more damage. Arcane Shade is mighty handy for both offense and retreating maneuvers!

Valentina slows the target enemy hero by 70% for 0.5s and gains the ability to cast their (Ultimate). Casting the enemy's (Ultimate) turns Valentina into the enemy hero's form and allows her to inherit their Basic Attack type for up to 12s. Her skills remain unchanged unless the enemy's (Ultimate) has a (Morph) effect.\nThe stolen (Ultimate)'s level will be equal to Valentina's (Ultimate) level and the cooldown will be 120% of the target's cooldown (but no lower than 10s). Valentina gains ( +100% Total Magic Power) (Physical Attack) for the duration if the enemy is a Physical Damage hero. This cannot be used on an enemy Valentina.
I Am You is the core of Valentina's skill set, allowing her to copy the enemy hero's form and Ultimate Skill, which essentially gives her unparalleled versatility and unlimited potential.

Valentina gains 8-50 extra EXP each time she deals damage to an enemy hero. Cooldown: 2s. \nIf the enemy hero's level isn't higher than Valentina's, 30% of the damage dealt is converted into her HP. The EXP scales with Valentina's level.
Primal Force is the secret weapon that ensures Valentina's always in the lead: the mechanism promises her advantages in terms of level and survivability.
Unique Passive - Mana Spring: Regenerates 15% Max Mana every 10s.
Unique Passive - Time: Gains 20 extra Max HP and 4 extra Magic Power every 20s, capped at 15 stacks.

Unique Passive - Recharge: Increases Magic Power by 5 after dealing Magic Damage (this effect stacks up to 6 times and can only gain 1 stack every 0.4s). When reaching full stacks, increases Magic Damage by 12% for 3s.
Unique Passive - Mystery: Gains 21%-35% extra Magic Power (scales with level).
Unique Passive - Guard: Gains a shield equal to 200% of Magic Power. The shield will regenerate 20s after being damaged, and grants 30 Movement Speed while it lasts.
